Change history

From 0.9.1, compatible fixes increment the last number (0.9.1 → 0.9.2). New features increment the middle number (0.9.2 → 0.10.0). We remain in initial development. See Semantic Versioning 2.0.0.

Earlier labels are preserved. The fixes labeled 0.3.0, 0.7.0, 0.8.0 and 0.9.0 should have used patch increments. Version labels 0.1.0–0.4.0 were added retrospectively in 0.5.0; the 0.7.0 and 0.8.0 entries were committed together. Git history does not establish a separate deployment for each entry.

Previously omitted development changes
  • September 13: added and corrected repository/deployment documentation (39a14d6, 01aa844).
  • September 13: added Cloudflare hosting and corrected its compatibility date (341753c, 0412e9b).
  • September 13: filled in Lithuanian judgment, long-life and birthday passages (38ddd88). The earlier bilingual release still had gaps.
  • September 13: excluded local deployment state from Git (d49d566).
  • September 13: added the first trailing-slash redirect (eec5da5), completed by the routing fixes below.

These commits did not have distinct game version numbers. Documentation and local tooling changes do not need standalone game releases.
